about_body: Learn Roboticks be a free an' open ship fer teachin' the art o' commandin' mechanical crew through tales an' a browser-borne proving-ground.
nav_account_info_tooltip: Yer loot be stashed in this here browser by default. To carry it 'cross ships, lash yer GitHub flag to the mast.
admin_body: Helm o' the ship — cap'n's controls.
admin_forbidden: Ye've no leave t' set foot in these quarters.
admin_stats_error: The ledger be smudged — tallies lost.
admin_users_error: The roster be lost at sea.
admin_users_confirm_delete: Keelhaul {name}? There be no comin' back.
home_course_intro_java: Introduction t' Java (fresh off the dock)
home_playground_link: Take th' Java compiler for a spin
settings_lang_english_body: Every lesson, every sign, every scroll be writ in the King's English.
settings_lang_pirate_body: Arrr, this here be a test, a mighty voyage across the briny deep, or somethin' like it, to make certain the translatin' riggin' holds fast for every last lesson aboard this vessel.
settings_lang_unsupported_notice_prefix: English be the only proper tongue 'board this vessel. If ye fancy translatin', chart yer course t'
settings_editor_theme_auto_hint: ★ hoisted automatic-like by the ship's light/dark flag.
settings_system_prompt_hint: Nailed to the lesson's bow when ye press Copy on a reading. Scribble here to steer how the oracle answers.
settings_code_system_prompt_hint: Nailed to the lesson, yer code, and the forge's ramblings when ye press Copy on a codin' lesson.
playground_idle_hint: Press Set sail t' compile. For now the Rust side mutters "compile not yet implemented" — this page proves the riggin' loads and the hatch be reachable.
error_404_title: This here page sailed off the map.
error_404_message: The page ye seek ain't in these waters. Mayhap it weighed anchor, or the chart be out o' date.
error_500_title: Trouble below decks on our end.
error_500_message_fallback: Somethin' unseemly happened whilst loadin' this page. Give 'er another try in a moment.
discord_adults_only_prefix: Right now the server is adults only. Students will be able to join once it's set up properly for them, with moderators and
discord_contact_prefix: Need to reach me in the meantime? Email
discord_contact_suffix: . If you're a student, please CC a trusted mentor.
discord_intro: The fastest way to get help with a lesson, flag a mistake, or talk to other students and mentors working through the course.
discord_ypp_suffix: Youth Protection Program's guidelines for online communication. Moderators follow those guidelines and the server rules, in that order.
discord_discord_safety: Discord's own teen safety defaults also apply automatically for members under 18.
discord_who_body: Students, mentors, and alumni. Adults with access to student channels are expected to clear Youth Protection screening before interacting with students.
discord_rule_dms_title: No private DMs between students and adults.
discord_rule_dms_body: All communication between students and mentors, alumni, or staff happens in public channels. If an adult messages you privately, tell a moderator or a parent. You won't be in trouble.
discord_rule_parents_title: Talk to your parents and mentors first.
discord_rule_parents_body_prefix: If you have questions about what to expect, see the
discord_rule_privacy_body: That includes your school, your city, photos of yourself, and your phone number.
discord_rule_in_person_title: Never meet in person someone you only know online.
discord_rule_in_person_body: Not even to hand off a part, not even at a competition, unless a parent or mentor you know in real life has arranged it.
discord_rule_instinct_body: If something feels uncomfortable, stop engaging and report it. You don't owe anyone an explanation.
discord_dms_off_tip: Tip: you can turn off DMs from server members in Discord's privacy settings, under Content & Social → Direct Messages.
discord_reporting_intro: If something goes wrong, you have more than one option:
discord_report_mod: Message a server moderator, or use modmail if the server has one.

discord_third_party_prefix: Discord is a separate service with its own
discord_third_party_suffix: . We can't control what happens outside this server.
discord_school_network: Discord may be blocked on school networks or school-managed devices, so a broken link isn't necessarily a bug.
discord_gate_check: I'm 13 or older, I've talked to a parent, guardian, or mentor about joining, and I've read the rules above.
discord_gate_locked: Check the box to show the join link.
